items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: Luis Russell was the bandleader, and in the band was Paul Barbarin, Red Allen, Charlie Holmes, and Luis Russell playing piano

ctx.x: Okay, I have to. Because before that.. When I mentioned Elmer Fain it makes me think of my first encounter with Louis Armstrong, which was on the 13th of November, 1937. I guess I was still a teenager. Anyhow, Pops Foster got sick, and I guess I was new in town then... Anyhow, Elmer Fain said, "Hey, kid, I got a job for you." I said, "What?" He said, "Louis Armstrong needs a bass player." So they were playing at the Vogue Ballroom on 9th and Grand in Los Angeles. You may remember that, too. But anyhow, they were…
